subject: APAC marketplace invoice: missing metering lines due to tombstoned events
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@edgecloud.ie>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@edgecloud.ie
Date: Tue, 25 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Missing line items on April AWS marketplace invoice (INV-202804-EC)

Hi Rafael / Naomi,

We're seeing a material gap on our April AWS marketplace invoice (INV-202804-EC). Several SKU lines we expect to see for APAC regions are missing entirely — the net is a $17.9k shortfall versus our usage records. I've attached the invoice PDF and a snippet of our internal metering CSV for the 04/01-04/30 window.

Key details:
- Customer: EdgeCloud Ltd (APAC clusters)
- Invoice: INV-202804-EC (issued 2028-04-02)
- Observed gap: ~USD 17,900 (missing SKUs: rbk-io-001, svm-burst-2)

This is blocking our month-end close. Can you confirm whether Redwood saw these meter events? If it's on your side we'll need a corrective invoice or credit memo and a timeline for remediation.

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround.

Liam O'Connor
Head of Cloud Ops
EdgeCloud Ltd
Attachment: edgecloud_invoice_202804.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: edgecloud_metering_snippet_202804.csv (text/csv)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@edgecloud.ie>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Missing line items on April AWS marketplace invoice (INV-202804-EC)

Hi Liam — thanks for flagging and for the attachments. Apologies for the friction.

Short answer: we see a signal that some APAC metering events did not make it into the billing ledger due to an ingestion edge case (late-arriving events that were tombstoned during dedupe). I'm opening a triage and will propose remediation within 48 hours. To help us scope the fix: can you confirm whether the attached metering snippet includes the complete set of affected SKUs and provide any additional examples (start/end timestamps)?

Provisional next steps (we'll refine internally):
- Run fast reconciliation to estimate the missing charge (provisional credit hold if required)
- Backfill tombstoned events into the ledger and re-run billing for April (if applicable)
- Issue either a corrective invoice or a credit memo, depending on ledger result

I'll loop in Naomi from Billing Ops to run the ingestion and accounting diagnostics. If we need a provisional credit for your month-end close we can issue an interim credit memo while we complete the reissue process.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Attachment: —

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@edgecloud.ie>
Date: Fri, 28 Apr 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Missing line items on April AWS marketplace invoice (INV-202804-EC) — initial diagnostics

Hi Liam / Rafael,

Thanks for the examples — I pulled the ingestion logs and ran a quick reconciliation against the April ingest window for APAC (ap-southeast-1 / ap-northeast-1). Findings: 

1) Root cause summary:
- Between 2028-04-02 23:40 UTC and 2028-04-03 02:10 UTC a replication delay caused a subset of meter events to arrive after our dedupe/tombstone cutoff. Those late-arriving events were marked as tombstoned in the intermediate store and never materialized to the billing ledger.
- The affected events map to the SKUs you called out (rbk-io-001, svm-burst-2) and a handful of smaller lines.

2) Impact estimate:
- Preliminary estimated shortfall: USD 18,150 (rounded). We'll confirm after full backfill.

3) Proposed remediation (7 business day target):
- Day 0–1: Run targeted backfill job for the tombstoned window and generate matched event list (attached: recon_apac_tombstones.csv).
- Day 2–4: Re-run billing ledger for affected accounts and create a corrected invoice / credit memo set.
- Day 5–7: Finance to issue credit memo (if negative delta) and reissue invoice as needed; notify marketplaces team for payout alignment.

4) VAT / tax note:
- We'll flag the corrective documents as adjustments referencing INV-202804-EC. For APAC customers we will not reverse collected VAT on the original invoice; instead the corrected invoice/credit will be explicit about VAT treatment. Finance needs to approve final wording.

Attachments:
- recon_apac_tombstones.csv (CSV) — list of affected event ids, timestamps, SKUs and estimated USD contribution
- runbook link: https://drive.google.com/fake-recon-link/edgecloud-apac-recon

I'll start the backfill this afternoon and will post an interim estimate by EOD Monday. Rafael — if you want to offer a provisional hold/credit to EdgeCloud while we complete reissue, we can prepare a credit memo template.

Naomi Feldman
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: recon_apac_tombstones.csv (text/csv)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 May 2028 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Missing line items on April AWS marketplace invoice — accounting steps

Adding a quick note from Finance perspective. Good catch by Naomi. A few accounting constraints we should follow so GAAP and VAT reporting remain clean: 

- Use a corrective credit memo that references the original invoice number (INV-202804-EC) and the reissued invoice number if we choose to reissue. For internal ledgers, we’ll book an accrual for the estimated shortfall once Naomi confirms the post-backfill number.
- VAT handling: do not reverse VAT already remitted without explicit Finance sign-off; instead the credit/invoice adjustment should mirror VAT lines (i.e., 'VAT adjustment - refer to INV-202804-EC').
- Payout timing: do not alter seller payouts until the corrected billing documents are finalized; if EdgeCloud needs a provisional credit for cashflow, we can issue a short-term credit memo and subsequently reconcile. 

Action items I’ll take: create an accrual code and a temporary ledger tag for DEAL-ACQ-2027-0047 so Finance can track adjustments and reconcile in the next close. Naomi — please ping me once you have the backfill results and the final USD number.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@edgecloud.ie>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, accounts-payable@edgecloud.ie
Date: Thu, 02 May 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Missing line items on April AWS marketplace invoice (INV-202804-EC) — remediation and timelines

Hi Liam — quick update and formal remediation plan. Apologies again for the disruption.

What we did:
- Naomi's team ran a targeted backfill and confirmed 1,145 tombstoned events that map to your SKUs and date window. The post-backfill delta is USD 18,120. (See attached recon CSV.)
- Finance created an accrual (ACCR-2028-0053) tied to DEAL-ACQ-2027-0047 and has prepped accounting entries.

Planned deliverables (timeline):
- Today: Issued provisional credit memo to help with your month-end close (attached: credit_memo_edgecloud_20280502.pdf). This is marked 'provisional — subject to final reissued invoice'.
- By 2028-05-08 (EOD): Finance will finalize corrected invoice set and/or official credit memo referencing INV-202804-EC. This will include precise VAT reconciliation language.
- By 2028-05-10: Payout team will reconcile marketplace remittances to ensure seller payout aligns with corrected ledger.

Requested action from EdgeCloud:
- Please confirm receipt of the provisional credit memo and whether you would like Redwood to proceed with reissuing the invoice or simply apply the credit against the next statement.
- If you have any finance/legal language requirements for VAT on the credit memo, please share them and we will incorporate.

Attachments:
- credit_memo_edgecloud_20280502.pdf (application/pdf) — provisional credit memo for USD 18,120
- recon_apac_tombstones.csv (text/csv) — affected event list

Thanks for your patience — we're prioritizing this and will keep you updated daily until it's closed.

Best regards,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | marketplace@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
